description: Create employee-scoped Timesheets CRUD sub-page at /employees/[id]/timesheets. Allows managing all timesheets (active and historical) for a single employee with add, edit inline, delete, and set-active functionality.
steps: Create src/app/employees/[id]/timesheets/page.tsx as a 'use client' page following the inline CRUD pattern from src/app/assets/page.tsx
Page header: back link to /employees/[id], employee name, title 'Horaires'
Fetch all timesheets for this employee from supabase .from('timesheets').select('*').eq('employee_id', id).order('is_active', {ascending: false}).order('start_date', {ascending: false})
Display timesheets as a list/table: 7 day columns (minutes -> Xh00 format), total, full_time_minutes, % temps, is_active badge, start_date, end_date, comment

Add form (toggle with + button): day inputs (number minutes for each day of week), full_time_minutes (default 2280), start_date, end_date, comment. On save, insert into timesheets table with employee_id.
Edit inline: clicking a row or pencil icon opens the form pre-filled with that timesheet's values. On save, update the row.
Delete with confirm dialog (window.confirm in French)
Set Active button: sets this timesheet is_active=true and all others for this employee is_active=false (only one active at a time)
Use minutesToHM helper (reuse pattern from profile page) for display
Mobile-first layout: card-based on small screens, table on md+. Use Tailwind responsive classes.
Use lucide-react icons: Clock, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Check, ArrowLeft
acceptance_criteria: Page loads at /employees/[id]/timesheets showing all timesheets for that employee
User can add a new timesheet with day-by-day minutes, full_time_minutes, dates, and comment
User can edit any existing timesheet inline
User can delete a timesheet with confirmation
User can set one timesheet as active (deactivating others)
Active timesheet is visually distinguished (badge or highlight)
Page compiles without TypeScript errors in next build
verification: Run `cd /projects/sandbox/WorkDays && npx next build` and confirm no build errors
